reason: Paying nothing upfront is decent, but it's a company in Kuwait with no clients, no reviews and nothing I can go and look at, and I've had three of these DMs this month already. I haven't got time to babysit a stranger over WhatsApp and then find out the 'extras' are where they make their money.
objection: What's the catch? 'Changes outside the scope cost extra' and they hold my domain and logins until I pay. If they set the scope tight, I'm stuck either paying for changes or walking away with nothing after wasting my evenings on calls.
would_change_my_mind: A 10-minute video call where I see a real site they've built and a fixed written price that covers a couple of rounds of changes, with the domain registered in my name from day one.
